review_text: This program introduced to your customers which you requested that they sign up with their phone number is a rip off. When they sign up for this explain to them the terms and conditions that comes with it. Don’t encourage them to get into it and then come up with information you can only get it when you do this or when you come back to shop, it is a rip off. It’s a savings to use on purchases, let them be able to use it when they want and it should be in your system for when they are ready to use it not when you want them to. Your new staffs need orientation. I requested for help today and I was redirected to be helped by someone else who never walked up to me to help but decided to flash a smile as I was walking out of your store. Wazobia, we know you to be the best, please stay and be the best. Don’t reduce your worth!!!

Hello Wazobia management, strip up, because this review will be a quite lengthy one. I have always have a pleasant experience in Wazobia Market over the couple of months, especially whenever my namesake Mr. Oluwafemi is on duty. He will practically walk me to what I was looking for on the shelf and even at the meat area he will take over the number calling atimes, jinger the Hispanic guys to accelerate the process until everyone is adequately served. I tried tipping him a couple of times just to appreciate him for his dedication but he refused the offer mumbling something like not seeking reward for help offered.... I even changed the tactics and decided to buy him lunch. He will just put up a smile and maintain his stance. Strange!!! However, during my recent visits I can't but notice I haven't seen him in a while. I initially thought he was not on shift but my subsequent visits without him on any of the shifts arose my curiosity, leading me to inquire about him, To my surprise I was told he was let go (fired) for no probable cause. I find that very difficult to believe. I know people that deserve to be let go in that establishment. People so sluggish in their duties that you only see them performing when their boss is around, but definitely not a charismatic being like him. Wazobia management, hear this, if that information is accurate, you just let go one of your finest, faultless employee, that is if he is not the best self. He possess a very gentle and kind heart, with great customer relation and interaction skills and given my last experience at the store which actually prompted me to write this review which for the record, I have never done before. I feel Wazobia Market let go of a prized employee. Mehn..., you find him everywhere in the store, from the meat area to greeting customers, to cashier table to the snacks and food area or even wheeling carts and baskets. I don't even know what his exact role was because you find him doing everything and anything. I don't know him personally but I recognize talent when I see one and @Wazobia, that guy is a talent. What a shame! Now that you let him go, please fix your meat area and the checkout area. It is so unfair for me to want to spend my hard earn money in a store and I have to wait almost an hour to get served and checked out. That is poor customer service in my book. Do something about it.

Completely as disrespectful as expected. I have been exposed to worse but upon entering black man I want to pray for more care by our people. I keep giving black culture a chance but it seems to only want my money over my business.Just grow like the rest of the United States.

Updating my review. I wnjoy coming here because of the customer service. But the meat area employees are so rude! Twice now I've been disrespected by them as if I'm bothering them and asked them to come in on their day off.

Please reduce the amount of salt and maggi you put in your food especially the jollof beans and your fried fish. As much as we would love to eat our Nigerian food doesn’t mean we should get hypertension. Thanks. Your uncooked produce are great btw.

What do you spray your ripe Plantain with? I bought about 12 plantain on Friday 10/10/25 by the time i got home they were turning BLACK, by the next day a couple them were super soft and soggy. Please, this unsafe practice must stop. I buy same product from Fiesta Mart and it takes it's NATURAL COURSE to slowly rippen. If this unsafe practice continues i would have to get the appropriate establishment involved. I have seen Videos online where unripe plantain and unripe bananas are dipped into Chemicals and brought out the immediate result is that they come out of the Chemicals looking YELLOW & RIPE. Every Customer's health is vital.

Un lugar demasiado increíble para ser verdad. La cultura africana está bien representada en esta tienda. Muy buena calidad de los productos y el servicio es de máxima excelencia. Recomiendo este lugar sin dudas y volvería aquí sin dudarlo
Jollof rice at the Beechnut location is far better than this one.
The service is super slow no motivation at all
Confusing, not well organized and a little high price compared to farmer's market

I am highly disappointed with this store, I bought Nestle baby Cerelac and I decided to return it the next day because I bought the wrong one but the store decided not to accept my return. I wanted to switch or get another cerelac , they didn’t accept. I will move to another store that honors exchange and customer’s satisfaction. I am disappointed .
Didn't really have stuff I was looking for, that comes from Ghana, or Nigeria, it seemed like it is a Mexican store.

I will always cheer Wazobia on for a lot of things, especially when it comes to customer service, cleanliness and product availability. There is a BUT….. of recent, I am not sure what’s been happening with the cashiers. Some of them look so disgruntled or upset. No greeting, no smile, no engagement with their customers until they get to the required membership question. I understand that standing on your feet all day attending to people can be a lot but I drive past other African stores to Wazobia for the customer service experience. Pls bring that back!
